response.what_it_is: Xbox One X console with controller and retail box
hidden_risks: Actual physical condition and wear of the console being sold
Controller functionality and presence of stick drift
Console hardware health (HDMI port, disc drive, overheating issues)
response.best_proof: A live photo showing the actual console powered on and displaying the dashboard
response.drop_reason: Seller is using stock or promotional photos instead of photos of the actual item
response.failure_mode: Valuing the item based on pristine promotional stock photos while the actual unit delivered may be scratched, faulty, or missing components.
